requirements: Bind review and QA to the current contract and explicitly declared environment
Keep legacy tasks readable and both adapters compatible

design.ownership: Common library owns freshness; board and orchestration call it
design.data: Optional plan revision/environment descriptor and hashed receipt
design.interfaces: plan accepts RequirementRevision and EnvironmentFile; gates compare current digest
design.states: planned, verified, stale after relevant drift
design.failureHandling: Reject changed or invalid descriptors and stale receipts without certifying completion
design.compatibility: Legacy plans without freshness retain source-only behavior; PS5.1 parsing uses supported flags
design.nonGoals: No automatic environment collection, global installation, live accounts, adaptive routing or deployment

acceptanceMapping.acceptance: Freshness and compatibility regressions pass on both PowerShell hosts
acceptanceMapping.verification: Focused drift/legacy/adversarial checks and full suites on PS7 and PS5.1, followed by independent review

newEvidence: Cross-host causal probe: PS5.1 JSON escapes raw HTML characters while PS7 emits them; same special-character goal produces different freshness hashes. Normalize only actual raw HTML characters in compressed JSON, preserving literal backslash-u sequences; verify Unicode and nested round trips.
